Ingredients:

- 1 package (8 oz) cream cheese, softened 
- 1/4 cup mayonnaise 
- 1/4 cup sour cream 
- 1/2 cup chopped black olives
- 1/2 cup chopped green olives 
- 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives 
- 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1/4 teaspoon pepper
- 5 flour tortillas (10 inch diameter)
- Fresh parsley leaves for garnish 

Instructions:

1. In a medium-sized bowl, combine the cream cheese, mayonnaise, and sour cream. Stir until well blended and smooth.

2. Add in the chopped black olives, green olives, chives, garlic powder, and pepper. Mix well until all ingredients are evenly distributed.

3. Spread an even layer of the olive cream mixture onto each of the tortillas, leaving about 1/2 inch around the edge of the tortilla.

4. Roll up each tortilla tightly, making sure to keep the filling inside. 

5. Wrap each rolled tortilla in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until firm. This will make slicing easier.

6. Once firm, use a sharp knife to cut the tortilla rolls into 1/2 inch slices.

7. Arrange the olive spirals on a serving plate with the cut-side facing up, so the spiral pattern is visible. 

8. Garnish with fresh parsley leaves before serving.

Enjoy these tasty and easy-to-make Olive Spirals as a perfect appetizer for your next party or gathering!
